cleansingStrength.rationale: Low by C6: no prominent strong anionic; the earliest prominent cleansing surfactant is the alkyl glucoside Decyl Glucoside@2. Counter-signal toward moderate: two prominent mild anionics (Disodium Laureth Sulfosuccinate@3, Sodium Lauryl Sulfoacetate@4) carry much of the cleansing, and there is no refatting or conditioning buffer in the prominent zone; this lowers confidence to moderate (neighbor moderate) but does not move the C6 value.

conditioningLevel.rationale: Low: cleansing-led architecture; the only conditioning route is one cationic starch polymer@11 after Parfum and both preservatives. No silicone, lipid, refatter, protein, pearlizing route or listed humectant. Neighbor moderate: a cationic starch is a recognized conditioning polymer (6.4) and could give noticeable slip.
